purpose: App Store Header artwork; not an application screenshot
prompts: Transform the reference concept completely into a refined abstract 2D editorial illustration for the App Store header of the infant diary app «Малыш». Keep only the subject idea: one adult bear looking at a phone and one baby bear nearby. Replace the 3D toy look entirely. No 3D rendering, plastic, porcelain, realistic fur, big glossy eyes, or realistic anatomy. Use sophisticated flat organic shapes, a few expressive curved lines, soft painted color transitions and subtle illustration texture, rounded yet graphic silhouettes, creamy ivory and warm peach characters. The adult bear is shown clearly in SIDE PROFILE FACING RIGHT, seated comfortably, head gently bowed toward a small plain muted-purple smartphone held in front of it on the right. A MUCH SMALLER infant cub, about one quarter of the adult's height, nestles immediately beside/behind the adult's left hip, looking up affectionately. Only these two characters and the phone. Very small simple dark facial marks, the profile muzzle unmistakably points right. The phone is an abstract graphic slab with no visible app UI, writing or logo. Beautiful seamless full-bleed painted gradient background: soft lilac through warm creamy peach into muted dusky lavender, calm and harmonious, no transparent background. Landscape banner 3840×1646 (approximately 2.33:1). Compose for a cropped App Store header: group centered horizontally, adult head approximately at 52% x / 43% y, phone near 62% x / 53% y, tiny cub near 39% x / 61% y. Keep both faces and the phone within central 43% width and middle 40% height; quieter gradient continues generously to both edges and the top. The adult may extend lower but all important features stay central. Attractive clear silhouette and strong readable relationship at small size. No text, letters, slogans, frame, screenshots, badges, symbols, extra objects or extra characters. Make it feel like an art-directed contemporary illustration, warm, simple and a little playful.

Edit this approved illustration with ONE focused scene change: put the tiny baby bear in a small cozy bassinet/cradle IN FRONT of the adult bear, on the right, rather than sitting behind the adult. Keep the exact existing abstract 2D painted style, softly textured organic shapes, warm peach/cream bears, beautiful lilac–peach gradient, simple facial marks, overall wide landscape composition and adult's right-facing profile. Preserve the adult bear's appearance and size. The tiny cub is nestled on its back in a simple rounded cream-and-soft-lavender cradle, with its little face clearly visible looking up toward the parent. The cradle is clearly in the foreground between the adult and the right side of the scene, not behind or at the back. The adult still holds the small purple smartphone in one paw above/beside the cradle, while the free paw rests gently on the cradle rim, visually conveying attentive care and connection with the baby. The phone has no visible interface, lettering or logo. Keep the infant very small compared with the adult. Make the cradle understated and graphic, with a soft curved base, no ornate wicker detail, no extra toys or objects. Keep both faces, the phone and the key cradle interaction in the central area that survives App Store cropping; extend the same gradient uninterrupted to all canvas edges. Same aspect ratio, no text, badges, frame, extra characters, or changes to the illustration's visual language.
